packageRules.description: Small updates merge by themselves once CI passes (both images built and smoke-tested as the server runs them, with a real data run; actionlint). Every update already waits 7 days after release (minimumReleaseAge). Major updates wait for Felix (as in arthought-blog, 2026-11-20)
A new Python 3.x (the image and requires-python) can break code, though Renovate calls it minor: it waits for Felix
